# nomatron_group (Resource)

Nomatron organization-scoped group resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_group" "example" {
  org_name       = nomatron_organization.example.name
  name           = "admins"
  description    = "Platform administrators"
  owner_username = "rbarnes"

  metadata = {
    team = "platform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the group.
- `owner_username` (String) Username that will own the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was created.
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID that owns the group.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Owner user ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was last updated.
